liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Desolation Row** (3 reviews): Reviewer loves the Desolation Row, calling it a nice version; Desolation Row is excellent, with Jerry's guitar clear and bright [14][15][17]
- **Slipknot!** (3 reviews): Favorite moment is the move from Help into Slipknot, where Jerry seems to recover after botching the usual transition; Slipknot is deep and twisted, though the Help>Slip>Franklin's sequence is sloppy in places [6][7][13]
- **Jack-A-Roe** (2 reviews): Jack-A-Roe is exceptional, with Jerry attacking it; Jack-A-Roe is impressive and rescues the set after a somewhat disjointed Walkin' Blues [15][17]
- **Broken Arrow** (2 reviews): Phil sings Broken Arrow, which has detractors, but reviewer defends it; Phil delivers an extra sweet Broken Arrow [14][17]
- **Help On The Way** (2 reviews): Jerry makes a mistake in Help on the Way; reviewer likes his tone afterward; In set two, Jerry is loud but the band makes missteps during Help on the Way [10][15]
- **Franklin's Tower** (2 reviews): Help>Slip>Frank is a high point of the show; Franklin's Tower is also strong [9][13]
- **Ramble On Rose** (1 review): Reviewer enjoyed the Ramble On Rose [10]
- **Attics Of My Life** (1 review): Attics of My Life was a nice surprise in the second set [7]

## The recordings

- **gd93-12-17.sbd.cole.19287.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 168 min; rated 3.36/5 by 11 [1]. Said about its sound: Jerry's sound is very nice on this board, but Phil is low in the mix; Soundboard sound is excellent: Jerry is even or slightly high in the mix, all instruments balanced [10][13]
- **gd93-12-17.neumann.vernon.7348.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 167 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [3]. Said about its sound: Audience recording has more than decent sound; Oakland Coliseum's hollow acoustics are less of a problem than usual [9]
- **gd1993-12-17.schoeps.litzenberger.86014.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 169 min; rated 3/5 by 2 [4]. Said about its sound: Schoeps recording is very nice, though the mix gets more jangled as the show goes on; Sound quality is not great because of the arena [14][16]
- **gd1993-12-17.sbd.miller.91961.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 168 min; rated 2/5 by 3 [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended the show; says Jerry was faltering and the performance has sloppy stretches alongside some interesting moments [6]
- Reviewer sat midway up the concourse; felt the mix was better there, and the light show used the whole arena [11]
- Jerry was tuning his guitar during many first-set songs, which reviewer blames for the sloppiness [11]
- Reviewer says this opened the last good run of shows they saw; Jerry steadily got sloppier from 1994 into 1995 [7]
- Jerry's vocals sound really good for a 1993 show [9]
- Reviewer calls it a typical mid-90s show with Jerry struggling throughout [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd93-12-17.sbd.cole.19287.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>DAT>C>DAT>CDR (via Chris Laughlin). Patch Source: shnid=7348 . Mastered & seeded by MattMan. [1]
- **gd93-12-17.neumann.vernon.7348.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Matt Vernon; source: Audience: Neumann KM140's [3]
- **gd1993-12-17.schoeps.litzenberger.86014.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK4's>Reutelhuber PreAmp>Technics SVM-D1 [4]
- **gd1993-12-17.sbd.miller.91961.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Thanks to Paul Scotton for the discs; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat -> CD D [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Wolfgang's: [Grateful Dead Laminate from Oakland Coliseum Arena, Dec 17, 1993 at Wolfgang's](https://www.wolfgangs.com/backstage-passes/grateful-dead/laminate/OCA931217-A.html) [19]
